primary_family.quantities: 12 sym candidate differences D and12 sym residuals (D-P)/t^2
primary_family.SE: sampleSD of16 complete randomization values / sqrt16
primary_family.residual_pairing: independent coefficient and validation streams, paired by randomization index; preserve coefficient component covariance
primary_family.prediction_precision_gate: whole residual/t^2 simultaneous interval contained in[-.01,.01]
primary_family.meaning_of_gate: fixed numerical prediction tolerance, not strict Taylor-bound theorem or risk equivalence

raw_control: all24 raw contrasts and signed odd/even decomposition descriptive means/SE only; no selected p-values
coefficient_reporting: full g,H,B and raw offdiagonals; sym h=tr(H)/3,b=tr(B)/3; ratio b/h reported only with positive estimated h and delta-method numerical SE; not certified global/local optimum
uncertainty_scope: conditional on all frozen trained proposals; R measures numerical randomization, not number of proposal-training repeats
symmetry_scope: antithetic local-state coupling plus exact state enumeration imposes g/offdiag cancellation; zeros are implementation checks, not new empirical discoveries
missing_or_failure_rule: all expected slots retained; no diagnostic/risk/pass-based inclusion; missing primary cells remain unresolved, no replacement seeds or increased budgets
